batteryKwh.note: usable. EV Database gives 95.0 kWh nominal / 91.0 kWh usable for the Lyriq-V's export NMC pack; CarExpert and Cadillac's MY27 AU spec sheet confirm Sport and V share the same 92 kWh pack, which Cadillac labels 'Battery Rated Energy 92 kWh' (between nominal and usable, so not taken as usable). Held 102 kWh was the old MY25/26 pack (EV Database: 102.0 usable / 106.8 nominal).

rangeKm.note: Cadillac AU MY27 spec sheet (August 2026), 'Max Range (WLTP)', footnote 2 names WLTP; Sport on 21-inch, V on 22-inch wheels, one wheel per grade. Same figure in CarExpert MY27 articles.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Cadillac AU spec sheet 'Combined electric energy consumption' (WLTP, includes charging losses); battery/range = 18.1, within tolerance.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: European figure for the same body, 588 L seats up (EV Database Lyriq-V page gives the same 588/1687). Cadillac AU's 793 L is to the roof (The Beep: '793 litres to the roof'), so replaced per the cargo-cover convention. The cited pages do not name the standard; German-market figures are conventionally VDA to the parcel shelf.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: European folded figure for the same body; probably VDA to the roof rather than to the belt line (no belt-line figure published). Cadillac AU quotes 1,722 L.

towKg.note: CarsGuide lists 0 kg braked for every 2026 Lyriq grade incl. V; CarsGuide review: 'not rated for towing in Australia'. Cadillac AU MY27 spec sheet lists no tow rating. Europe rates it 1,587 kg, so an AU rating could appear.

warrantyYears.note: 5 years, unlimited km, unconditional; battery 8 yr/160,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: carried anchor: held Lyriq value at the same $90,000; between cadillac-optiq (2500 at $80,000) and cadillac-vistiq (3000 at $116,000), above ford-mustang-mach-e-gt 2800

depreciationCurve.note: One Cadillac brand curve, chosen as [1,0.66,0.54,0.45,0.38,0.32] (the held cadillac-vistiq curve, also used by volvo-ex90): thin local volume, no VFACTS reporting and the 2026 $32,000 cut justify a steep premium-EV curve; the held Lyriq-only [..0.64..0.31] curve priced the cut's one-off re-basing of pre-cut cars, which a car bought at today's $90,000 no longer carries. All Cadillac rows should share this curve.

availability.note: Cadillac AU Lyriq page with BUILD & PRICE link to shop.cadillacanz.com configurator (configurator is a JS app; its price API was not fetched). CarExpert 1 and 5 Sep 2026: Sport AWD is the sole MY27 regular grade, Luxury dropped.
